deferred.missing: The operator publishes an exact dynamic Charge Flex formula and a dynamic Charge Adhoc flow, but there is no safe static prefix-wide kWh value. Charge Flex uses a 0.349 EUR/kWh base plus the EPEX-SPOT-linked 15-minute component at session start; the spot component at charging start applies to the whole session. The current ad-hoc price is likewise time-dependent and published separately. A static stored value would become wrong.
deferred.unblock: A runtime/source resolver that reads the operator-published time-dependent price at charging start (or an equivalent primary public tariff payload) so the dynamic component is evaluated rather than frozen.
